Indian stock market analysts offer buy recommendations for September 4

Several Indian financial news outlets published stock recommendations for September 4, 2026. Analysts provided specific stock picks, including Capri Global Capital Ltd, Engineers India Ltd, and Acme Solar Holdings. Experts offered technical outlooks and trade strategies, with some focusing on intraday supports and resistances for Nifty50 stocks. Nifty futures were reported to exhibit a positive bias.
